scientific_integrity: Analytic Gevrey endpoint proof and Fourier aliasing establish infinite claims; standalone numerical checks are illustrative, not proof of asymptotic sharpness.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional Gaussian exponential moment, Cauchy quantile mapping, exact arithmetic, single uniform shift; exponent sharp only as all-n RMS envelope; no every-n lower bound, global method optimality, floating-point guarantee, or independent publication-priority certification.
title: Sharp Gevrey barrier for Cauchy-mapped Gaussian quadrature
